# Camera barcode library

`html5-qrcode-2.3.8.min.js` is the unmodified browser bundle from the official
`html5-qrcode@2.3.8` npm package. Its Apache 2.0 license is included alongside it.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/html5-qrcode/-/html5-qrcode-2.3.8.tgz

Package integrity (SHA-512):
`jsr4vafJhwoLVEDW3n1KvPnCCXWaQfRng0/EEYk1vNcQGcG/htAdhJX0be8YyqMoSz7+hZvOZSTAepsabiuhiQ==`

Serve it locally and asynchronously: an unavailable camera download must not
prevent the store from loading its delivery or using the Netum/count controls.
